title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. translated_title: StereoVLM：用于度量三维空间推理的双目视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）展现出强大的语义理解能力，但在对物理世界中度量三维空间的推理方面仍然存在局限。现有的VLM通常从一个或多个图像中推断三维场景结构，而缺乏已知的相机标定或跨视角几何约束。这使得度量三维推断本质上具有歧义性，也无法确定其空间预测究竟是基于视觉证据，还是主要由语义先验驱动。相比之下，经过标定的双目立体视觉提供了显式的跨视角几何信息，能够消除这种歧义，为度量三维感知和几何泛化提供更可靠的基础。我们研究了VLM如何直接从标定的双目观测中学习可迁移的三维表征。为此，我们提出了StereoVLM，这是首个用于度量三维空间推理的几何感知双目视觉语言模型。StereoVLM遵循一种分层学习范式……
tldr: 提出了首个几何感知的双目视觉语言模型StereoVLM，利用标定双目相机的显式跨视角几何消除现有VLM在度量三维空间推理中的歧义。
en_tdlr: StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular vision-language model, leverages explicit cross-view geometry from calibrated stereo to resolve ambiguity in metric 3D spatial reasoning.
